messages:
hannah: following the postmortem, recurring paging for 'auth-service token errors' is still causing churn. want a concrete plan for noise reduction that preserves true outages.

kevin: saw ~200 alerts across 3 nights, many identical and coming from the same upstream host. pages were mostly P2s at 02:20AM.

olga: proposal: 1) add a short quiet-window for background token refreshers (02:00-03:00 UTC) that converts p2 -> digest; 2) increase the per-instance threshold from 3->8 over 2m; 3) dedupe key = upstream_host + error_code + client_id.

frank: +1 to dedupe. also recommend a metric override: if auth_error_rate cluster-wide > 250/min then bypass suppression and page immediately. Keeps us safe for real regressions.

hannah: agree. also want an annotation with last-success timestamp and a service owner tag so ops can triage without unpacking logs.

alert-bot: runbook updated by @hannah -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-token-errors

kevin: quick rule sketch I validated in staging: ```yaml
alert: AuthTokenFailures
expr: sum(rate(auth_token_errors[1m])) by (upstream_host, client_id)
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: p2
annotations:
  summary: "Auth token failures ({{ $labels.upstream_host }})"
```

Add dedupe labels: `fingerprint = upstream_host + client_id + error_code`

olga: timeline suggestion: - PR for threshold + dedupe by Thu EOD - staging deploy Fri AM - 72h monitoring - prod rollout next Tue if green. Owners: kevin (PR & rule tests), hannah (runbook + owner tags), frank (monitor + rollback).

hannah: i also want a small dashboard tile that shows suppressed vs paged counts and top fingerprints. helps validate impact quickly.

frank: i'll add a Grafana panel and a short alert-reduction report job to post results into #eng-oncall after 24h.

kevin: dedupe window proposal: 20m default, prod clusters 10m. auto-close suppressed duplicates after 25m but reopen if error rate increases >2x in 10m.

olga: sounds good. for critical clients we can make product-specific exceptions (reduce dedupe window). i'll maintain an exceptions list in the runbook.

hannah: action recap: kevin -> PR with thresholds + dedupe labels; hannah -> runbook updates + exceptions list; frank -> dashboard + monitoring job; olga -> merge policy + prod exceptions. Target: PR merged Thu EOD.

alert-bot: @channel On-call this weekend: Fri -> @kevin, Sat -> @olga, Sun -> @hannah.

kevin: i'll start the PR now and post a staging screenshot. ping me if you want to pair.

hannah: thanks team. reconvene next Wed 10am after post-rollout metrics are in. :thumbsup:

olga: ACK, will schedule the follow-up and invite owners.

frank: i'll post the first 24h reduction numbers to #eng-oncall after staging verification.```
